name: Torturing
body:
Cost +2 bonus; Aura moderate necromancy; CL 10th; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This special ability can only be placed on melee weapons.

A torturing weapon deals 1 additional point of non-lethal damage when it hits a creature. For the next 2d6 rounds, the creature takes an additional point of non-lethal damage per round. Multiple hits from a torturing weapon increase the non-lethal damage. Tortured creatures take the non-lethal damage at the start of their turns. The non-lethal damage can be stopped by a successful DC 12 Heal check or through the application of any spell that cures hit point damage.

A critical hit does not multiply the non-lethal damage.

Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to the non-lethal damage dealt by this weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells touch of fatigue
